name: Painful Severing (Combat)
body:
You do more than just cut off your opponent’s limbs.

Prerequisite: Base attack bonus +10, Heal 9 ranks.

Benefit: When you successfully sever a limb, you deal normal weapon damage to your victim.

Normal: When you sever a limb, no damage is dealt.
